description: Unit tests for the SchemefulSite class in the net namespace, covering origin comparison, serialization, scheme handling, and conversion functions.

classes.name: SchemefulSite
classes.description: Represents a schemeful site based on a URL origin, with methods for serialization, comparison, and scheme handling.

methods.name: CreateIfHasRegisterableDomain
methods.description: Creates a SchemefulSite if the origin has a registerable domain.

methods.name: FromWire
methods.description: Creates a SchemefulSite from a wire format, given an origin.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the SchemefulSite to a string.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a string into a SchemefulSite.

methods.name: SerializeFileSiteWithHost
methods.description: Serializes a file scheme site with host information.

methods.name: DeserializeWithNonce
methods.description: Deserializes a SchemefulSite with nonce information.

methods.name: ConvertWebSocketToHttp
methods.description: Converts WebSocket schemes to HTTP schemes for comparison.

methods.name: GetURL
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the SchemefulSite.
